def utc() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def identity(info: os.stat_result) -> tuple[int, int]:
    return info.st_dev, info.st_ino


def directory(relative: str = "") -> int:
    held = os.open(LAB, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        assert os.fstat(held).st_uid == os.getuid()
        for name in relative.split("/") if relative else ():
            assert name not in {"", ".", ".."} and re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+", name)
            child = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=held)
            os.close(held)
            held = child
            assert os.fstat(held).st_uid == os.getuid()
        return held
    except BaseException:
        os.close(held)
        raise


def read_fd(fd: int, limit: int) -> bytes:
    before = os.fstat(fd)
    assert stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_uid == os.getuid()
    assert before.st_nlink == 1 and 0 <= before.st_size <= limit
    raw = os.pread(fd, limit + 1, 0)
    after = os.fstat(fd)
    assert len(raw) == before.st_size and len(raw) <= limit
    assert (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) == (
        after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns,
    )
    return raw


def bounded(relative: str, limit: int = 128 * 1024, *, private: bool = False) -> bytes:
    parent, _, name = relative.rpartition("/")
    assert name not in {"", ".", ".."} and "/" not in name
    root = directory(parent)
    try:
        fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=root)
        try:
            if private:
                assert stat.S_IMODE(os.fstat(fd).st_mode) == 0o600
            return read_fd(fd, limit)
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(root)


def unique(pairs: list[tuple[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        assert key not in result, "duplicate JSON key"
        result[key] = value
    return result


def decode(raw: bytes, limit: int = 128 * 1024) -> Any:
    assert len(raw) <= limit
    return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=unique,
                      parse_constant=lambda _: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError("nonfinite JSON")))


def write_new(relative: str, value: object, cap: int = 128 * 1024) -> tuple[int, int]:
    raw = (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode("ascii")
    assert len(raw) <= cap
    parent, _, name = relative.rpartition("/")
    root = directory(parent)
    try:
        fd = os.open(name, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600, dir_fd=root)
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            owned = identity(os.fstat(stream.fileno()))
            stream.write(raw)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.fsync(root)
        return owned
    finally:
        os.close(root)


def remove_private(owned: tuple[int, int]) -> bool:
    root = directory()
    try:
        try:
            info = os.stat(PRIVATE, dir_fd=root, follow_symlinks=False)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return False
        assert identity(info) == owned and stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
        assert info.st_uid == os.getuid() and info.st_nlink == 1
        os.unlink(PRIVATE, dir_fd=root)
        os.fsync(root)
        return True
    finally:
        os.close(root)


def source_pins(head: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", head)
    assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=SOURCE, text=True).strip() == head
    assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%G?"], cwd=SOURCE, text=True).strip() == "G"
    assert not subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], cwd=SOURCE)
    values = {}
    for name in CODE:
        fd = os.open(SOURCE / name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
        try:
            raw = read_fd(fd, 2 * 1024 * 1024)
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
        values[name] = {"size": len(raw), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
    return values


def assets() -> dict[str, Any]:
    root = SOURCE / "web/workspace/dist"
    assert root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink()
    values: dict[str, Any] = {}
    total = 0
    for parent, dirs, names in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
        assert len(values) + len(dirs) + len(names) <= 256
        assert all(not (Path(parent) / name).is_symlink() for name in dirs)
        for name in names:
            path = Path(parent) / name
            fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
            try:
                raw = read_fd(fd, 4 * 1024 * 1024)
            finally:
                os.close(fd)
            total += len(raw)
            assert total <= 32 * 1024 * 1024
            values[path.relative_to(root).as_posix()] = {
                "size": len(raw), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            }
    assert "index.html" in values and 1 <= len(values) <= 256
    return dict(sorted(values.items()))


def settings_guard() -> None:
    value = tomllib.loads(bounded("worker/worker.toml", 65536).decode("utf-8"))
    assert value["listen"] == "127.0.0.1:8100"
    assert value["openshell"].get("daemon", True) is True
    assert {tuple(c["projects"]) for c in value["clients"]} == {(PROJECT,), (OTHER,)}
    assert value["openshell"]["environments"]["profiles"]["minimal"].startswith("sandbox-science/minimal:")
    # No settings object, token bytes or settings/config hash escapes this function.


def record(project: str = PROJECT) -> ProjectRecord:
    assert project in (PROJECT, OTHER)
    return ProjectRecord.model_validate_json(
        bounded(f"orch/provisioning-workspace/projects/{project}.json", 1024 * 1024), strict=True,
    )


def registry_check(value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    project, other = record(), record(OTHER)
    assert project.project_id == PROJECT and other.project_id == OTHER
    assert project.profile == other.profile == "minimal"
    assert project.policy == other.policy == value["policy"]
    assert set(project.sessions) == set(SESSIONS) and set(other.sessions) == {"unserved"}
    assert project.default_environment_id == value["environments"]["shared"]
    assert project.sessions["shared-a"].environment_id == project.default_environment_id
    assert project.sessions["shared-b"].environment_id == project.default_environment_id
    dedicated = project.sessions["dedicated"]
    assert dedicated.environment_id == value["environments"]["dedicated"] and dedicated.dedicated
    assert not project.sessions["shared-a"].dedicated and not project.sessions["shared-b"].dedicated
    assert all(s.closed_at is None for s in project.sessions.values())
    assert other.default_environment_id not in value["environments"].values()
    assert other.default_environment_id == value["other_environment"]


def guard(head: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    pins = source_pins(head)
    settings_guard()
    value = decode(bounded(MARKER, 32 * 1024))
    assert value["version"] == 1 and type(value["version"]) is int
    assert value["project"] == PROJECT and value["purpose"] == PURPOSE
    assert value["source_head"] == head and value["inputs"] == pins
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", value["run_id"])
    assert value["helper_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    registry_check(value)
    held = directory("orch/provisioning-workspace")
    try:
        assert stat.S_IMODE(os.fstat(held).st_mode) == 0o700
    finally:
        os.close(held)
    return value


def init(head: str) -> None:
    pins = source_pins(head)
    settings_guard()
    policies = [bounded(name, 128).decode("ascii").strip() for name in (
        "policy.digest", "lab30-escalate-policy.digest",
    )]
    assert all(re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", p) for p in policies)
    assert policies[0] != policies[1]
    root = directory()
    try:
        for name in ("orch", "evidence"):
            with contextlib.suppress(FileExistsError):
                os.mkdir(name, 0o700, dir_fd=root)
    finally:
        os.close(root)
    root = directory("orch")
    try:
        os.mkdir("provisioning-workspace", 0o700, dir_fd=root)
    finally:
        os.close(root)
    store = ProjectStore(CONTROL)
    project, created = store.create(PROJECT, "minimal", policies[0])
    assert created
    for session in SESSIONS:
        store.open_session(PROJECT, session, dedicated=session == "dedicated")
    other, created = store.create(OTHER, "minimal", policies[0])
    assert created
    store.open_session(OTHER, "unserved", dedicated=False)
    value = {
        "version": 1, "project": PROJECT, "purpose": PURPOSE, "source_head": head,
        "inputs": pins, "run_id": uuid.uuid4().hex,
        "helper_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "policy": policies[0], "escalation_policy": policies[1],
        "environments": {"shared": project.default_environment_id,
                         "dedicated": record().sessions["dedicated"].environment_id},
        "other_environment": other.default_environment_id,
    }
    write_new(MARKER, value, 32 * 1024)
    guard(head)
    save(value, "init", {"registry": [record().model_dump(mode="json"), record(OTHER).model_dump(mode="json")]})


def save(marker: dict[str, Any], name: str, payload: object) -> None:
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,47}", name)
    write_new("evidence/provisioning-workspace-" + name + ".json", {
        "source_head": marker["source_head"], "run_id": marker["run_id"],
        "project_id": PROJECT, "observed_at": utc(), "payload": payload,
    }, 2 * 1024 * 1024)


def evidence(marker: dict[str, Any], name: str) -> Any:
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,47}", name)
    value = decode(bounded("evidence/provisioning-workspace-" + name + ".json", 2 * 1024 * 1024), 2 * 1024 * 1024)
    assert value["source_head"] == marker["source_head"] and value["run_id"] == marker["run_id"]
    assert value["project_id"] == PROJECT
    return value["payload"]


async def serve(head: str) -> None:
    marker = guard(head)
    build = assets()
    token = uuid.uuid4().hex + uuid.uuid4().hex
    worker = WorkerClient(WORKER, bounded("worker/client-a.token", 4096, private=True).decode().strip())
    app = create_app(ProjectStore(CONTROL), SOURCE / "web/workspace/dist", login_token=token, job_worker=worker)
    runner = web.AppRunner(app, access_log=None)
    stop = asyncio.Event()
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT):
        loop.add_signal_handler(sig, stop.set)
    owned = None
    port = None
    errors: list[str] = []
    try:
        await runner.setup()
        site = web.TCPSite(runner, "127.0.0.1", 0)
        await site.start()
        assert len(runner.addresses) == 1
        port = runner.addresses[0][1]
        assert type(port) is int and 1024 < port < 65536
        owned = write_new(PRIVATE, {
            "source_head": head, "run_id": marker["run_id"],
            "login_url": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/login?token={token}", "port": port,
        }, 4096)
        save(marker, "server", {"port": port, "pid": os.getpid(), "assets": build,
                               "inputs": marker["inputs"], "helper_sha256": marker["helper_sha256"]})
        print(json.dumps({"stage": "serve", "port": port, "pid": os.getpid(),
                          "source_head": head, "run_id": marker["run_id"]}), flush=True)
        await stop.wait()
    finally:
        for close in (runner.cleanup, worker.close):
            try:
                await close()
            except BaseException as error:
                errors.append(type(error).__name__)
        removed = False
        if owned is not None:
            try:
                removed = remove_private(owned)
            except BaseException as error:
                errors.append(type(error).__name__)
        save(marker, "workspace-cleanup", {"utc": utc(), "port": port,
             "runner_cleanup_attempted": True, "private_removed": removed,
             "private_created_by_this_process": owned is not None, "errors": errors})
        for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT):
            loop.remove_signal_handler(sig)
        assert not errors, "workspace cleanup did not complete"


def same_observation(left: BaseModel, right: BaseModel) -> None:
    assert type(left) is type(right)
    assert left.model_dump(mode="json", exclude={"observed_at"}) == right.model_dump(mode="json", exclude={"observed_at"})


class Checks:
    def __init__(self, head: str, marker: dict[str, Any], worker: aiohttp.ClientSession,
                 gui: aiohttp.ClientSession, base: str) -> None:
        self.head, self.marker, self.worker, self.gui, self.base = head, marker, worker, gui, base

    def context(self, session: str) -> dict[str, str]:
        assert session in SESSIONS
        found = record().sessions[session]
        return {"project_id": PROJECT, "session_id": session, "environment_id": found.environment_id}

    async def call(self, which: str, method: str, path: str, *, body: object = None,
                   expected: tuple[int, ...] = (200,), cap: int = 64 * 1024) -> tuple[int, Any]:
        guard(self.head)
        assert which in ("worker", "gui") and method in ("GET", "POST")
        assert path.startswith("/v1/") if which == "worker" else path.startswith("/api/v0/")
        assert not any(c in path for c in ("#", "\\", "\x00"))
        http, base = (self.worker, WORKER) if which == "worker" else (self.gui, self.base)
        async with asyncio.timeout(12):
            async with http.request(method, base + path, json=body, allow_redirects=False,
                                    auto_decompress=False) as response:
                raw = bytearray()
                count = 0
                async for chunk in response.content.iter_chunked(8192):
                    count += 1
                    assert count <= 256 and len(raw) + len(chunk) <= cap
                    raw.extend(chunk)
                status = response.status
                assert status in expected, (which, path.split("?")[0], status)
                if which == "gui":
                    assert response.headers.get("Cache-Control") == "no-store"
                value = decode(bytes(raw), cap) if raw else None
                # Never export raw error messages. A status+kind is sufficient.
                if status >= 400:
                    value = {"error_kind": value.get("error", {}).get("kind") if type(value) is dict else None}
                return status, value

    def paths(self, environment: str, suffix: str = "", query: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> tuple[str, str]:
        assert environment in self.marker["environments"].values()
        worker = f"/v1/environments/{environment}/provisioning/observations" + suffix
        gui = f"/api/v0/projects/{PROJECT}/environments/{environment}/provisioning/observations" + suffix
        wquery = {"project_id": PROJECT, **(query or {})}
        return worker + "?" + urlencode(wquery), gui + ("?" + urlencode(query) if query else "")

    async def pair(self, model: type[Model], environment: str, suffix: str = "",
                   query: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> Model:
        paths = self.paths(environment, suffix, query)
        values = []
        for which, path in zip(("worker", "gui"), paths, strict=True):
            raw = (await self.call(which, "GET", path))[1]
            typed = model.model_validate_json(json.dumps(raw), strict=True)
            assert typed.project_id == PROJECT and typed.environment_id == environment  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            values.append(typed)
        same_observation(values[0], values[1])
        return values[0]

    async def detail(self, environment: str, provision: str, seq: int | None = None) -> ProvisionDetail:
        assert re.fullmatch(r"prv-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,120}", provision)
        result = await self.pair(ProvisionDetail, environment, "/operations/" + provision,
                                 None if seq is None else {"seq": seq})
        assert result.summary.provision_id == provision
        assert seq is None or result.summary.seq == seq
        return result

    async def submit(self, name: str, session: str, capability: str) -> str:
        assert (name, session, capability) in (
            ("install", "shared-a", "gp"), ("permission", "dedicated", "python-flint"),
            ("sibling", "dedicated", "gp"),
        )
        operation = "lab30-" + name + "-" + self.marker["run_id"]
        _, value = await self.call("worker", "POST", "/v1/provisioning", expected=(201,), cap=128 * 1024,
                                 body={"operation_id": operation, "context": self.context(session),
                                       "purpose": PURPOSE + ": " + name, "capability": capability})
        assert value["request"]["operation_id"] == operation
        assert value["request"]["context"]["project_id"] == PROJECT
        provision = value["provision_id"]
        assert type(provision) is str and re.fullmatch(r"prv-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,120}", provision)
        save(self.marker, name + "-submitted", {"provision_id": provision, "operation_id": operation,
                                                "context": self.context(session), "capability": capability})
        return provision

    async def wait_detail(self, environment: str, provision: str, *, permission: bool = False) -> ProvisionDetail:
        # Poll one worker-only bounded detail to avoid false parity during a live transition.
        path, _ = self.paths(environment, "/operations/" + provision)
        async with asyncio.timeout(900):
            while True:
                _, value = await self.call("worker", "GET", path)
                found = ProvisionDetail.model_validate_json(json.dumps(value), strict=True)
                assert (found.project_id, found.environment_id, found.summary.provision_id) == (PROJECT, environment, provision)
                if found.summary.state == "finished" or (permission and found.summary.state == "awaiting_permission"):
                    return found
                await asyncio.sleep(0.25)

    async def files(self, environment: str, detail: ProvisionDetail) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        offset = 0
        for _ in range(250):
            page = await self.pair(ProvisionFilePage, environment, "/operations/" + detail.summary.provision_id + "/files",
                                   {"seq": detail.summary.seq, "offset": offset, "limit": 8})
            assert (page.provision_id, page.seq, page.offset, page.limit, page.total) == (
                detail.summary.provision_id, detail.summary.seq, offset, 8, detail.summary.files_total)
            rows.extend(f.model_dump(mode="json") for f in page.files)
            if page.next_offset is None:
                assert len(rows) == page.total
                return rows
            offset = page.next_offset
        raise AssertionError("bounded file page count exhausted")

    async def history(self, environment: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        rows, probes, after, target = [], [], -1, None
        for _ in range(64):
            query = {"after": after, "limit": 8}
            if target is not None:
                query["target"] = target
            page = await self.pair(RevisionSummaryPage, environment, "/revisions", query)
            assert page.after == after and page.limit == 8
            if target is None:
                target = page.target
            assert page.target == target
            for revision in page.revisions:
                rows.append(revision.model_dump(mode="json"))
                offset, found = 0, []
                for _ in range(8):
                    selected = await self.pair(RevisionProbePage, environment, f"/revisions/{revision.revision}/probes",
                                               {"pin": revision.record_sha256, "offset": offset, "limit": 8})
                    assert (selected.revision, selected.record_sha256, selected.offset, selected.limit, selected.total) == (
                        revision.revision, revision.record_sha256, offset, 8, revision.probes_total)
                    found.extend(p.model_dump(mode="json") for p in selected.probes)
                    if selected.next_offset is None:
                        break
                    offset = selected.next_offset
                assert len(found) == revision.probes_total
                probes.append({"revision": revision.revision, "record_sha256": revision.record_sha256, "probes": found})
            if page.next_after is None:
                assert len(rows) <= page.retained_total  # Older-than-window absence remains explicit.
                return {"target": target, "first_retained": page.first_retained,
                        "retained_total": page.retained_total, "revisions": rows, "probes": probes}
            after = page.next_after
        raise AssertionError("bounded history page count exhausted")

    async def initial(self) -> None:
        for kind, policy in (("shared", self.marker["policy"]), ("dedicated", self.marker["escalation_policy"])):
            await self.call("worker", "POST", "/v1/environments", expected=(201,), body={
                "project_id": PROJECT, "environment_id": self.marker["environments"][kind],
                "profile": "minimal", "policy": policy,
            })
        _, choices = await self.call("gui", "GET", f"/api/v0/projects/{PROJECT}/provisioning/environments")
        assert choices["project_id"] == PROJECT
        assert set(choices["environment_ids"]) == set(self.marker["environments"].values())
        observations = {}
        for kind, environment in self.marker["environments"].items():
            value = await self.pair(ProvisionObservation, environment)
            assert value.queue_total == 0 and value.gate.mode == "ready"
            observations[kind] = value.model_dump(mode="json")
        foreign = self.marker["other_environment"]
        status, _ = await self.call("gui", "GET", f"/api/v0/projects/{PROJECT}/environments/{foreign}/provisioning/observations", expected=(404,))
        other_status, _ = await self.call("gui", "GET", f"/api/v0/projects/{OTHER}/environments/{foreign}/provisioning/observations", expected=(404,))
        save(self.marker, "initial", {"choices": choices, "observations": observations,
                                    "foreign_environment_status": status, "unserved_project_status": other_status,
                                    "sql": sql_snapshot(self.marker)})

    async def install(self) -> None:
        before = evidence(self.marker, "initial")["observations"]["shared"]["current_revision"]
        environment = self.marker["environments"]["shared"]
        provision = await self.submit("install", "shared-a", "gp")
        done = await self.wait_detail(environment, provision)
        assert done.summary.outcome == "completed" and done.summary.revision_after is not None
        assert done.summary.revision_before is not None
        assert done.summary.revision_after > done.summary.revision_before
        assert before is None or done.summary.revision_after > before
        done = await self.detail(environment, provision, done.summary.seq)
        files = await self.files(environment, done)
        history = await self.history(environment)
        selected = next(r for r in history["revisions"] if r["revision"] == done.summary.revision_after)
        assert selected["operation"] == provision
        proof = next(p for p in history["probes"] if p["revision"] == selected["revision"])
        assert any(p["name"] == "gp-factor" and p["status"] == "passed" for p in proof["probes"])
        stale = max(0, done.summary.seq - 1)
        assert stale != done.summary.seq
        statuses = []
        for which, path in zip(("worker", "gui"), self.paths(environment, "/operations/" + provision, {"seq": stale}), strict=True):
            statuses.append((await self.call(which, "GET", path, expected=(409,)))[0])
        pin = selected["record_sha256"]
        wrong = ("0" if pin[0] != "0" else "1") + pin[1:]
        for which, path in zip(("worker", "gui"), self.paths(environment, f"/revisions/{selected['revision']}/probes", {"pin": wrong, "offset": 0, "limit": 8}), strict=True):
            statuses.append((await self.call(which, "GET", path, expected=(409,)))[0])
        current = await self.detail(environment, provision)  # Explicit current retained-history selection.
        assert current.summary.seq == done.summary.seq
        save(self.marker, "install", {"detail": done.model_dump(mode="json"), "files": files,
             "history": history, "selected_current_detail": current.model_dump(mode="json"),
             "stale_pin_statuses": statuses, "sql": sql_snapshot(self.marker)})

    async def permission_wait(self) -> None:
        evidence(self.marker, "install")
        environment = self.marker["environments"]["dedicated"]
        provision = await self.submit("permission", "dedicated", "python-flint")
        pending = await self.wait_detail(environment, provision, permission=True)
        assert pending.summary.state == "awaiting_permission" and pending.summary.permission_request is not None
        sibling = await self.submit("sibling", "dedicated", "gp")
        queue = await self.pair(ProvisionObservation, environment)
        assert queue.queue_total == 2 and [p.provision_id for p in queue.operations] == [provision, sibling]
        assert queue.operations[0].state == "awaiting_permission" and queue.operations[1].state == "queued"
        pending = await self.detail(environment, provision, pending.summary.seq)
        files = await self.files(environment, pending)
        assert any(f["action"] == "escalate" for f in files)
        save(self.marker, "permission-wait", {"detail": pending.model_dump(mode="json"),
             "files": files, "queue": queue.model_dump(mode="json"), "sibling": sibling,
             "operator_decision_required": True, "sql": sql_snapshot(self.marker)})
        print(json.dumps({"stage": "permission-wait", "permission_request": pending.summary.permission_request,
                          "provision_id": provision, "queued_sibling": sibling}), flush=True)

    async def permission_finish(self) -> None:
        pending = evidence(self.marker, "permission-wait")
        environment = self.marker["environments"]["dedicated"]
        first = pending["detail"]["summary"]["provision_id"]
        done = await self.wait_detail(environment, first, permission=True)
        if done.summary.state == "awaiting_permission":
            print(json.dumps({"stage": "permission-finish", "waiting": True,
                              "permission_request": done.summary.permission_request}), flush=True)
            return
        assert done.summary.outcome == "completed"
        sibling = await self.wait_detail(environment, pending["sibling"], permission=True)
        if sibling.summary.state == "awaiting_permission":
            # Explicitly record a second root decision; never approve it here.
            save(self.marker, "sibling-permission", {"detail": sibling.model_dump(mode="json")})
            print(json.dumps({"stage": "permission-finish", "waiting": True,
                              "permission_request": sibling.summary.permission_request}), flush=True)
            return
        assert sibling.summary.outcome in ("completed", "already_satisfied")
        done = await self.detail(environment, first, done.summary.seq)
        sibling = await self.detail(environment, pending["sibling"], sibling.summary.seq)
        history = await self.history(environment)
        assert any(p["name"] == "flint-factor" and p["status"] == "passed"
                   for row in history["probes"] for p in row["probes"])
        queue = await self.pair(ProvisionObservation, environment)
        assert queue.queue_total == 0
        save(self.marker, "permission-finish", {"first": done.model_dump(mode="json"),
             "sibling": sibling.model_dump(mode="json"), "first_files": await self.files(environment, done),
             "sibling_files": await self.files(environment, sibling), "history": history,
             "queue": queue.model_dump(mode="json"), "sql": sql_snapshot(self.marker)})

    async def idle_inspect(self) -> None:
        # Root invokes once while worker offline, then once after live-worker idle suspension.
        evidence(self.marker, "permission-finish")
        before = sql_snapshot(self.marker)
        proof_path = LAB / "evidence/provisioning-workspace-gateway-stopped.json"
        if proof_path.exists():
            proof = gateway_proof(self.marker, decode(bounded("evidence/provisioning-workspace-gateway-stopped.json", 16384)))
            calls = []
            for _ in range(30):
                for kind, environment in self.marker["environments"].items():
                    value = await self.pair(ProvisionObservation, environment)
                    calls.append({"environment": kind, "observation": value.model_dump(mode="json")})
                await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
            after = sql_snapshot(self.marker)
            assert before == after, "read-only stopped observation changed retained worker state"
            save(self.marker, "idle-inspect", {"phase": "stopped", "gateway": proof,
                 "calls": calls, "before": before, "after": after, "sql_unchanged": True})
        else:
            calls = []
            for environment in self.marker["environments"].values():
                _, path = self.paths(environment)
                status, value = await self.call("gui", "GET", path, expected=(503,))
                calls.append({"environment_id": environment, "status": status, **value})
            after = sql_snapshot(self.marker)
            assert before == after
            save(self.marker, "offline-inspect", {"phase": "worker_offline", "calls": calls,
                 "before": before, "after": after, "sql_unchanged": True})


def sql_snapshot(marker: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Bounded mode=ro allowlisted facts; no endpoint/auth/config/policy payloads."""
    environments = tuple(sorted(marker["environments"].values()))
    assert len(environments) == 2 and len(set(environments)) == 2
    root = directory("worker/state")
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    total = 0
    try:
        for name in ("worker.sqlite3", "environments.sqlite3"):
            fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=root)
            try:
                info = os.fstat(fd)
                assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_uid == os.getuid() and info.st_nlink == 1
                assert 0 < info.st_size <= 128 * 1024 * 1024
                assert os.pread(fd, 16, 0) == b"SQLite format 3\0"
                db = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{LAB / 'worker/state' / name}?mode=ro", uri=True, timeout=0.1)
                try:
                    db.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
                    ticks = 0
                    def budget() -> int:
                        nonlocal ticks
                        ticks += 1
                        return int(ticks > 20000)
                    db.set_progress_handler(budget, 1000)
                    db.execute("BEGIN")
                    if name == "environments.sqlite3":
                        rows = db.execute("SELECT environment_id,substr(CAST(document AS BLOB),1,65537) FROM environments WHERE environment_id IN (?,?) ORDER BY environment_id", environments).fetchall()
                        assert len(rows) == 2
                        values = []
                        for env, raw in rows:
                            value = decode(raw, 65536)
                            assert value["project_id"] == PROJECT and value["environment_id"] == env
                            values.append({k: value[k] for k in ("project_id", "environment_id", "sandbox", "sandbox_id", "state")})
                        result["environments"] = values
                    else:
                        tables = (
                            ("provisions", "provision_id", "record"),
                            ("revision_entries", "revision", "record"),
                            ("kernel_start_revisions", "session_id,language", "record"),
                        )
                        for table, order, column in tables:
                            count = db.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {table} WHERE environment_id IN (?,?)", environments).fetchone()[0]
                            assert type(count) is int and count <= 128
                            rows = db.execute(f"SELECT environment_id,substr(CAST({column} AS BLOB),1,65537) FROM {table} WHERE environment_id IN (?,?) ORDER BY environment_id,{order}", environments).fetchall()
                            values = []
                            for env, raw in rows:
                                assert type(raw) is bytes and len(raw) <= 65536
                                total += len(raw)
                                assert total <= 8 * 1024 * 1024
                                values.append({"environment_id": env, "size": len(raw), "record_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
                            result[table] = values
                        for table, columns, order in (
                            ("executor_endpoints", "environment_id,substr(incarnation,1,129),substr(sandbox,1,129),substr(sandbox_id,1,129)", "environment_id"),
                            ("kernels", "environment_id,substr(session_id,1,129),substr(language,1,16),substr(incarnation,1,129),base,last", "environment_id,session_id,language"),
                            ("package_execution_gates", "environment_id,generation,substr(mode,1,32),substr(operation,1,129),revision", "environment_id"),
                            ("environment_revisions", "environment_id,revision,substr(fingerprint,1,129),substr(changed_by,1,129)", "environment_id"),
                            ("executions", "environment_id,substr(execution_id,1,129),substr(session_id,1,129),terminal", "environment_id,execution_id"),
                        ):
                            rows = db.execute(f"SELECT {columns} FROM {table} WHERE environment_id IN (?,?) ORDER BY {order} LIMIT 129", environments).fetchall()
                            assert len(rows) <= 128 and all(type(x) in (str, int, type(None)) for row in rows for x in row)
                            assert all(not isinstance(x, str) or len(x) <= 128 for row in rows for x in row)
                            result[table] = rows
                    db.rollback()
                finally:
                    db.close()
                assert identity(os.fstat(fd)) == identity(os.stat(name, dir_fd=root, follow_symlinks=False))
                fresh = directory("worker/state")
                try:
                    assert identity(os.fstat(fresh)) == identity(os.fstat(root))
                finally:
                    os.close(fresh)
            finally:
                os.close(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(root)
    return result


def gateway_proof(marker: dict[str, Any], value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    assert type(value) is dict and set(value) == {"version", "source_head", "run_id", "project_id", "observed_at", "sandboxes"}
    assert type(value["version"]) is int and value["version"] == 1
    assert (value["source_head"], value["run_id"], value["project_id"]) == (marker["source_head"], marker["run_id"], PROJECT)
    when = datetime.fromisoformat(value["observed_at"])
    assert when.tzinfo is not None and abs((datetime.now(UTC) - when).total_seconds()) <= 300
    assert type(value["sandboxes"]) is list and len(value["sandboxes"]) == 2
    retained = sql_snapshot(marker)["environments"]
    expected = {(e["environment_id"], e["sandbox"], e["sandbox_id"]) for e in retained}
    actual = set()
    for row in value["sandboxes"]:
        assert type(row) is dict and set(row) == {"environment_id", "name", "id", "phase"}
        assert all(type(v) is str and 0 < len(v) <= 128 for v in row.values())
        assert row["phase"] == "Stopped"
        actual.add((row["environment_id"], row["name"], row["id"]))
    assert actual == expected
    return value


def inspect(head: str, marker: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    server = evidence(marker, "server")
    assert server["assets"] == assets() and server["inputs"] == source_pins(head)
    initial = evidence(marker, "initial")
    installed = evidence(marker, "install")
    finished = evidence(marker, "permission-finish")
    assert installed["detail"]["summary"]["outcome"] == "completed"
    assert finished["first"]["summary"]["outcome"] == "completed"
    assert initial["observations"]["shared"]["queue_total"] == 0
    save(marker, "inspect", {"inputs": server["inputs"], "assets": server["assets"],
                              "sql": sql_snapshot(marker), "stage_records_validated": 4,
                              "scope": "real provisioning/UI reads; no scientific, recovery or operator-authority claim"})


async def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("stage", choices=STAGES)
    parser.add_argument("--head", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.stage == "init":
        init(args.head)
        return
    marker = guard(args.head)
    if args.stage == "serve":
        await serve(args.head)
        return
    if args.stage == "inspect":
        inspect(args.head, marker)
        return
    info = decode(bounded(PRIVATE, 4096, private=True), 4096)  # Never export/hash.
    assert set(info) == {"source_head", "run_id", "login_url", "port"}
    assert (info["source_head"], info["run_id"]) == (args.head, marker["run_id"])
    parsed = urlsplit(info["login_url"])
    assert parsed.scheme == "http" and parsed.hostname == "127.0.0.1"
    assert parsed.path == "/login" and parsed.port == info["port"]
    assert re.fullmatch(r"token=[0-9a-f]{64}", parsed.query) and not parsed.fragment
    base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{parsed.port}"
    async with (
        aiohttp.ClientSession(headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + bounded("worker/client-a.token", 4096, private=True).decode().strip()}, timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=12)) as worker,
        aiohttp.ClientSession(cookie_jar=aiohttp.CookieJar(unsafe=True), timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=12)) as gui,
    ):
        try:
            async with gui.get(info["login_url"], allow_redirects=False) as response:
                assert response.status == 303
                assert len(await response.content.read(4097)) <= 4096
        except (aiohttp.ClientError, TimeoutError):
            raise RuntimeError("private workspace login unavailable") from None
        checks = Checks(args.head, marker, worker, gui, base)
        await getattr(checks, args.stage.replace("-", "_"))()
    guard(args.head)
    print(json.dumps({"stage": args.stage, "result": "PASS", "source_head": args.head,
                      "run_id": marker["run_id"]}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""Actual AST-extracted helper guards, tiny owned fixtures, no application import/RPC."""
import ast
import asyncio
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import signal
import sqlite3
import stat
import subprocess
import tempfile
import tomllib
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any
from unittest.mock import patch

FILE=Path('/tmp/provisioning-workspace-lab30-candidate.py')
raw=FILE.read_bytes()
parsed=ast.parse(raw)
functions={n.name:n for n in parsed.body if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef))}
names=('utc','identity','directory','read_fd','bounded','unique','decode','error_projection','write_new','remove_private','source_pins','gateway_proof','sql_snapshot','assets')
ns=dict(os=os,re=re,stat=stat,json=json,hashlib=hashlib,Path=Path,Any=Any,
        datetime=datetime,timedelta=timedelta,UTC=UTC,sqlite3=sqlite3,subprocess=subprocess)
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[functions[n] for n in names],type_ignores=[]),str(FILE),'exec'),ns)
results=[]
def check(name,call):
    result=call()
    assert result is not False
    results.append({'name':name,'passed':True})
    print('PASS',name,flush=True)
def refuses(call):
    try: call()
    except (AssertionError,ValueError,OSError,sqlite3.Error): return
    raise AssertionError('expected refusal')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='lab30-helper-guard-') as temp:
    root=Path(temp); ns['LAB']=root; ns['SOURCE']=root; ns['PRIVATE']='private.json'; ns['PROJECT']='lab30'
    (root/'evidence').mkdir(); (root/'worker/state').mkdir(parents=True)
    check('bounded_regular_exact',lambda: ((root/'safe').write_bytes(b'abc') == 3 and ns['bounded']('safe',3)==b'abc'))
    check('oversize_preflight',lambda: refuses(lambda:ns['bounded']('safe',2)))
    (root/'link').symlink_to(root/'safe')
    check('final_symlink_refused',lambda:refuses(lambda:ns['bounded']('link',10)))
    os.mkfifo(root/'fifo')
    check('fifo_nonblocking_regular_guard',lambda:refuses(lambda:ns['bounded']('fifo',10)))
    (root/'dirlink').symlink_to(root/'evidence',target_is_directory=True)
    check('parent_symlink_refused',lambda:refuses(lambda:ns['bounded']('dirlink/no',10)))
    check('parent_traversal_refused',lambda:refuses(lambda:ns['bounded']('../safe',10)))
    os.link(root/'safe',root/'hard')
    check('hardlink_refused',lambda:refuses(lambda:ns['bounded']('hard',10)))
    (root/'hard').unlink()
    def growth():
        original=os.pread
        def changed(fd,limit,offset):
            data=original(fd,limit,offset)
            (root/'safe').write_bytes(b'abcdef')
            return data
        with patch.object(os,'pread',changed): refuses(lambda:ns['bounded']('safe',10))
    check('growth_identity_refused',growth)
    def private_owned():
        owned=ns['write_new']('private.json',{'synthetic':'not a token'})
        assert stat.S_IMODE((root/'private.json').stat().st_mode)==0o600
        assert ns['bounded']('private.json',100,private=True)
        refuses(lambda:ns['write_new']('private.json',{}))
        assert ns['remove_private'](owned)
        assert not (root/'private.json').exists()
    check('private_exclusive0600_exact_cleanup',private_owned)
    def private_replaced():
        owned=ns['write_new']('private.json',{})
        (root/'private.json').rename(root/'retained-private')
        ns['write_new']('private.json',{'replacement':True})
        refuses(lambda:ns['remove_private'](owned))
        assert (root/'private.json').exists()
        (root/'private.json').unlink(); (root/'retained-private').unlink()
    check('private_replacement_preserved',private_replaced)
    def mode():
        ns['write_new']('private.json',{})
        (root/'private.json').chmod(0o644)
        refuses(lambda:ns['bounded']('private.json',100,private=True))
        (root/'private.json').unlink()
    check('private_wrong_mode_refused',mode)
    check('duplicate_json_raw_refused',lambda:refuses(lambda:ns['decode'](b'{"action":"deny","action":"allow"}')))
    check('escaped_duplicate_refused',lambda:refuses(lambda:ns['decode'](b'{"action":1,"\\u0061ction":2}')))
    check('nonfinite_json_refused',lambda:refuses(lambda:ns['decode'](b'{"x":NaN}')))

# Lab30 provisioning workspace acceptance helper plan

This helper is a disposable, root-owned acceptance recipe. It does not provide a product API or operator interface. Author checks will use tiny temporary fixtures and extracted pure guards only; all real HTTP, installs, policy decisions, services, VMs, and browser actions belong to root after independent review.

Fixed scope is project `lab30`, shared environment `lab30-default` (sessions `shared-a` and `shared-b`), dedicated environment `lab30-dedicated` (session `dedicated`), and an unserved `lab30b` project. Canonical ProjectStore records drive contexts; arbitrary project, environment, command, URL, path, policy selector, or gateway operation is unavailable.

Stages are `init`, `serve`, `initial`, `install`, `permission-wait`, `permission-finish`, `idle-inspect`, and `inspect`. Each requires an owned non-symlink `~/.local/state/openshell-lab` and a source-clean, signed exact root-supplied HEAD. A private marker binds this run, source, registry, fixed lab purpose, and recorded policy digests. `init` creates only the fresh lab-local registry/marker; it reads fixed normal and escalation policy digest files registered by root for this lab. `serve` uses the real production create_app and WorkerClient, pins every bounded emitted GUI asset, and creates exactly one loopback runner. Its login file is exclusive mode 0600 and is never hashed, logged, copied, or exported. Cleanup removes only the exact file identity created by this invocation, drains runner/client cleanup, and records public cleanup metadata. Root owns the remaining lab tree and service/VM teardown.

`initial` creates only the two fixed worker environments with the corresponding registered normal/escalation policy; then compares validated bounded worker and workspace summary/detail/page DTOs (excluding trusted receipt timestamps), validates shared/dedicated registry choices and foreign-scope refusal, and records explicit queue/gate/revision facts. `install` submits a fixed catalog `gp` request to the shared environment, polls only bounded current detail, then validates completion, changed revision, functional catalog probe, exact selected detail/file/revision/probe pins, full finite page coverage, stale seq409 and wrong raw-revision pin409. Submission responses are bounded and reduced to safe operation identity; no full-operation response is retained.

`permission-wait` submits fixed `python-flint` to the dedicated escalation environment, waits for a real awaiting_permission request, submits a fixed queued `gp` sibling, and records the real bounded queue/file decisions/permission request. It prints no decision command or policy authority; root's existing operator CLI answers the recorded request separately. `permission-finish` observes the first operation's actual terminal outcome (expected root approval -> completed) and the sibling's real progress, without fabricating a second decision. If a second permission request appears, it is recorded and the stage is rerunnable after root answers it. No helper permit/deny/cancel/install-policy mutation exists.

`idle-inspect` is observation-only. Root may first stop the worker or arrange actual idle suspension and write a fixed sanitized gateway proof file. The helper verifies exact run/project/environment/managed VM identity and Stopped phase for supplied fixed proof, compares bounded allowlisted SQLite before/after snapshots, and calls only read-only workspace/worker observation endpoints. Worker-offline 503 is recorded separately from a live worker observing a stopped VM. A stopped VM may still have valid durable provisioning records: the recipe never requires empty/unavailable durable summaries and never wakes or checks active status. Root supplies independent gateway lifecycle proof; helper SQL and endpoint reads cannot prove the VM's state by themselves.

`inspect` validates retained public stage records, immutable source/assets, canonical registry and bounded allowlisted worker SQL (no daemon endpoint, auth, config pin, keys, token data, or raw gateway annotations). It does not repair or backfill records.

All HTTP calls use fixed loopback origins, no redirects/compression, whole deadlines, bounded response bytes/chunks, unique JSON keys, typed strict DTOs and exact scope/page/selection validation. No raw error body, full operation, package-cache log, private worker settings, raw gateway output, or provider data is exported. Public evidence is fixed-name exclusive JSON with finite size and source/run pins. Actual install/probe and real browser assertions remain separate from local guard probes. No recovery/corruption, scientific correctness, whole CP26, durable agent notification, or producer proof claim is made.

Proposed safe root prerequisites: run worker_up.sh with PROJECT=lab30; register the lab-only escalate Conda policy using existing operator CLI; place its digest at the fixed `lab30-escalate-policy.digest`; production build; exact final signed HEAD. Root opens the private login URL locally without exporting it, drives the Environment panel, performs explicit permission decisions, configures idle/restarts, captures sanitized gateway proof, stops the helper, and completes owned teardown.

def utc() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def identity(info: os.stat_result) -> tuple[int, int]:
    return info.st_dev, info.st_ino


def directory(relative: str = "") -> int:
    held = os.open(LAB, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        assert os.fstat(held).st_uid == os.getuid()
        for name in relative.split("/") if relative else ():
            assert name not in {"", ".", ".."}
            assert re.fullmatch("[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+", name)
            child = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=held)
            os.close(held)
            held = child
            assert os.fstat(held).st_uid == os.getuid()
        return held
    except BaseException:
        os.close(held)
        raise


def read_fd(fd: int, limit: int) -> bytes:
    before = os.fstat(fd)
    assert stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode)
    assert before.st_uid == os.getuid()
    assert before.st_nlink == 1
    assert 0 <= before.st_size <= limit
    raw = os.pread(fd, limit + 1, 0)
    after = os.fstat(fd)
    assert len(raw) == before.st_size
    assert len(raw) <= limit
    assert (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) == (
        after.st_dev,
        after.st_ino,
        after.st_size,
        after.st_mtime_ns,
    )
    return raw


def bounded(relative: str, limit: int = 128 * 1024, *, private: bool = False) -> bytes:
    parent, _, name = relative.rpartition("/")
    assert name not in {"", ".", ".."}
    assert "/" not in name
    root = directory(parent)
    try:
        fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=root)
        try:
            if private:
                assert stat.S_IMODE(os.fstat(fd).st_mode) == 0o600
            return read_fd(fd, limit)
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(root)


def unique(pairs: list[tuple[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        assert key not in result, "duplicate JSON key"
        result[key] = value
    return result


def decode(raw: bytes, limit: int = 128 * 1024) -> Any:
    assert len(raw) <= limit
    return json.loads(
        raw.decode("utf-8"),
        object_pairs_hook=unique,
        parse_constant=lambda _: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError("nonfinite JSON")),
    )


def write_new(relative: str, value: object, cap: int = 128 * 1024) -> tuple[int, int]:
    raw = (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode("ascii")
    assert len(raw) <= cap
    parent, _, name = relative.rpartition("/")
    root = directory(parent)
    try:
        fd = os.open(name, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600, dir_fd=root)
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            owned = identity(os.fstat(stream.fileno()))
            stream.write(raw)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.fsync(root)
        return owned
    finally:
        os.close(root)


def remove_private(owned: tuple[int, int]) -> bool:
    root = directory()
    try:
        try:
            info = os.stat(PRIVATE, dir_fd=root, follow_symlinks=False)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return False
        assert identity(info) == owned
        assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
        assert info.st_uid == os.getuid()
        assert info.st_nlink == 1
        os.unlink(PRIVATE, dir_fd=root)
        os.fsync(root)
        return True
    finally:
        os.close(root)


def source_pins(head: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", head)
    assert (
        subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=SOURCE, text=True).strip() == head
    )
    assert (
        subprocess.check_output(["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%G?"], cwd=SOURCE, text=True).strip()
        == "G"
    )
    assert not subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], cwd=SOURCE)
    values = {}
    for name in CODE:
        fd = os.open(SOURCE / name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
        try:
            raw = read_fd(fd, 2 * 1024 * 1024)
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
        values[name] = {"size": len(raw), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
    return values


def assets() -> dict[str, Any]:
    root = SOURCE / "web/workspace/dist"
    assert root.is_dir()
    assert not root.is_symlink()
    values: dict[str, Any] = {}
    total = 0
    for parent, dirs, names in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
        assert len(values) + len(dirs) + len(names) <= 256
        assert all(not (Path(parent) / name).is_symlink() for name in dirs)
        for name in names:
            path = Path(parent) / name
            fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
            try:
                raw = read_fd(fd, 4 * 1024 * 1024)
            finally:
                os.close(fd)
            total += len(raw)
            assert total <= 32 * 1024 * 1024
            values[path.relative_to(root).as_posix()] = {
                "size": len(raw),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            }
    assert "index.html" in values
    assert 1 <= len(values) <= 256
    return dict(sorted(values.items()))


def settings_guard() -> None:
    value = tomllib.loads(bounded("worker/worker.toml", 65536).decode("utf-8"))
    assert value["listen"] == "127.0.0.1:8100"
    assert value["openshell"].get("daemon", True) is True
    assert {tuple(c["projects"]) for c in value["clients"]} == {(PROJECT,), (OTHER,)}
    assert value["openshell"]["environments"]["profiles"]["minimal"].startswith(
        "sandbox-science/minimal:"
    )
    # No settings object, token bytes or settings/config hash escapes this function.


def record(project: str = PROJECT) -> ProjectRecord:

    return ProjectRecord.model_validate_json(
        bounded(f"orch/provisioning-workspace/projects/{project}.json", 1024 * 1024),

def registry_check(value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    project, other = record(), record(OTHER)
    assert project.project_id == PROJECT
    assert other.project_id == OTHER
    assert project.profile == other.profile == "minimal"
    assert project.policy == other.policy == value["policy"]
    assert set(project.sessions) == set(SESSIONS)
    assert set(other.sessions) == {"unserved"}
    assert project.default_environment_id == value["environments"]["shared"]
    assert project.sessions["shared-a"].environment_id == project.default_environment_id
    assert project.sessions["shared-b"].environment_id == project.default_environment_id
    dedicated = project.sessions["dedicated"]
    assert dedicated.environment_id == value["environments"]["dedicated"]
    assert dedicated.dedicated
    assert not project.sessions["shared-a"].dedicated
    assert not project.sessions["shared-b"].dedicated
    assert all(s.closed_at is None for s in project.sessions.values())
    assert other.default_environment_id not in value["environments"].values()
    assert other.default_environment_id == value["other_environment"]


def guard(head: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    pins = source_pins(head)
    settings_guard()
    value = decode(bounded(MARKER, 32 * 1024))
    assert value["version"] == 1
    assert type(value["version"]) is int
    assert value["project"] == PROJECT
    assert value["purpose"] == PURPOSE
    assert value["source_head"] == head
    assert value["inputs"] == pins
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", value["run_id"])
    assert value["helper_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    registry_check(value)
    held = directory("orch/provisioning-workspace")
    try:
        assert stat.S_IMODE(os.fstat(held).st_mode) == 0o700
    finally:
        os.close(held)
    return value

    pins = source_pins(head)
    settings_guard()
    policies = [
        bounded(name, 128).decode("ascii").strip()
        for name in (
            "policy.digest",
            "lab30-escalate-policy.digest",
        )
    ]
    assert all(re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", p) for p in policies)
    assert policies[0] != policies[1]
    root = directory()
    try:
        for name in ("orch", "evidence"):
            with contextlib.suppress(FileExistsError):
                os.mkdir(name, 0o700, dir_fd=root)
    finally:
        os.close(root)
    root = directory("orch")
    try:
        os.mkdir("provisioning-workspace", 0o700, dir_fd=root)
    finally:
        os.close(root)
    store = ProjectStore(CONTROL)
    project, created = store.create(PROJECT, "minimal", policies[0])
    assert created
    for session in SESSIONS:
        store.open_session(PROJECT, session, dedicated=session == "dedicated")
    other, created = store.create(OTHER, "minimal", policies[0])
    assert created
    store.open_session(OTHER, "unserved", dedicated=False)
    value = {
        "version": 1,
        "project": PROJECT,
        "purpose": PURPOSE,
        "source_head": head,
        "inputs": pins,
        "run_id": uuid.uuid4().hex,
        "helper_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "policy": policies[0],
        "escalation_policy": policies[1],
        "environments": {
            "shared": project.default_environment_id,
            "dedicated": record().sessions["dedicated"].environment_id,
        },
        "other_environment": other.default_environment_id,
    }
    write_new(MARKER, value, 32 * 1024)
    guard(head)
    save(
        value,
        "init",
        {"registry": [record().model_dump(mode="json"), record(OTHER).model_dump(mode="json")]},
    )
